note: Ground-floor adverbs hall (the commonest time adverbs). Adverbs have no gender, so there is no left/right split. The archway on the far left goes back to the weeks room; the wooden staircase on the right goes UP to the first-floor clock room. Zoom: the writing desk against the back wall.
